findings.title: Restore root and standalone PostgreSQL harness binding for Transfer and Search
findings.trigger: Root composer test:pg, executed hosted PG18 job112898736741 on final HEAD
findings.impact: Three PostgreSQL Search tests fail before assertions with Target class [config] does not exist; the fourth added test is not grouped pg in the root harness. Both root PHP8.4/8.5 hermetic jobs fail8 cases (6 Transfer SQL,1 Transfer resume,1 Search phrase) with missing db/db.schema;1496 pass/7286 assertions.
findings.cause: File-level uses(PgTestCase::class)->group(pg) was removed, relying on package tests/Pest.php; root tests/Pest.php does not bind Search. The new test at line147 ends at169 without its own pg group. Transfer SQL file-level PgTestCase/pg declaration was likewise removed; root binds neither package. New ReleaseResumeTest also relies only on package Pest.php.
findings.repair: P09.13/P09.14 should restore consistent root/standalone TestCase initialization and pg selection/exclusion, retaining all behavior assertions.
findings.additional_evidence: PG16 job112898737029 repeats the same three Search failures;237passed/4801assertions. Same F1, no new finding.

findings.title: Cover the new CRM boundary paths enough to preserve the existing 95% gate
findings.trigger: Hosted CRM job112898736744 runs unchanged composer test:coverage with min95
findings.impact: All71tests/340assertions pass, but measured94.3% coverage exits1 below required95%. Mandatory ordinary CI is red.
findings.cause: New Value boundary helper has66.7% coverage, with integer-string/range handling lines44-52 and rejection paths18,27,59,64,82,95 unexecuted. The measured total demonstrates the gate deficit; exact attribution of every uncovered line to the total is not assumed.
findings.repair: P09.3 should add meaningful accepted/rejected boundary coverage and re-establish the existing95% requirement without reducing/excluding the source denominator.
